title: Shared lighting, shadows, depth, and composition
start_policy: Start now using published candidates, frozen inputs, or explicit local proxies; integration_inputs are convergence obligations, not start gates.
scope: Own shared sun, moon, ambient, exposure, form shading, caster/receiver behavior, contact and cast shadows, depth, transparency, and emissive ordering.
acceptance: Every category shares one environment and coherent shadow direction; noon, sunset, midnight, and sunrise match the reference ordering; overlap and transparency are physically plausible and deterministic.
Unsharpened contact-definition controls at both zooms, day/night, and scrolling prove grounding without halos, double-darkening, tile smudges, or incorrect receiver leakage.

Dense existing-city witnesses prove mutual building shadows, roof/facade separation, readable unlit night architecture, and localized emissives without light leaks or whole-city glow; initial acceptance does not depend on Q7 completion.
